title: Listen to Every Flower - How to Earn & Missable Status
description: Listen to Every Flower trophy in Phantom Blade Zero - how to earn it, whether it is missable, and how the PS5 and Steam lists differ.
keyword: Listen to Every Flower phantom blade zero trophy

sections.title: Overview
sections.content: Memory Flowers also gate the Dusk encounter and the Lion Dance Grandmaster, so this one doubles as progress rather than being a detour.

sections.title: Source Status
sections.content: Trophy 28 of 36 on the list - before it Overwhelming Force · after it Phantom Arsenal. It is not missable, so a missed run can be finished later without a restart. The full list with rarity is on the trophy list; the Platinum route and the order to do things in are on the trophy guide.
